_comment: Upstream dblp.org table-of-contents page headline (h1) for every conference edition captured in this mirror, fetched verbatim from the corresponding dblp.org/db/<stream>/<toc>.html page on 2026-09-30 (Anubis PoW gate solved as the upstream JavaScript does; see provenance.json). The mirror's edition pages render this short display name as the headline and page title, matching upstream's display convention; the full proceedings title remains the edition's stored title and stays visible in the venue page edition list metadata and the record/BibTeX data. Journal volumes are not listed: upstream journal volume pages show the full volume title, which the mirror already renders.
